text: Add dialog: suggest recent backlog items while the Name field is empty

Done. Add-item dialog now suggests recent backlog items (most-recently-touched first, capped at 5) as tap-to-pick suggestions while Name is blank; typing switches back to the existing live registry search. Reuses pickSuggestion() (T-33) and the existing suggestion-row UI as-is -- no AddItemDialog.kt changes needed. Introduced listIdFlow so the suggestions flow reacts correctly to listId being set (was a plain var, previously harmless only because blank-query suggestions were always empty). Commit 6f5858b.
